causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Demand for electricity was higher than expected for most high priced trading intervals. For the 12.30 pm trading interval, demand for electricity was 1599 MW, around 160 MW higher than forecast four hours prior.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Low-priced wind generation in South Australia was relatively low, as forecast.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Network outages in South Australia and Victoria, advised to the market over a week in advance, reduced the ability for low-priced electricity to flow into South Australia from Victoria.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The constraints to manage the outage on the Tailem Bend to Tungkillo line limited the flow of electricity across the Heywood interconnector while the constraints managing the Ararat to Horsham line outage limited flows across the MurrayLink interconnector, from Victoria into South Australia.

constraints_named.quote: AEMO invoked the V::S_ SETB_TBSE_2 constraint to manage the outage of the Tailem Bend to Tungkillo 275 kV line.
